meta.cr_name: Seamless Lodgment - Post Lodgment Withdrawal & ELS Cost API
meta.note: Regression fixture: building this spec must reproduce Dev 31 MD / Total 47 MD.

user_interaction.details:
Withdraw
1. Allow user to Withdraw instrument(s)
2. Allow user to Confirm for Withdrawal before user can proceed to 'Withdraw'
Copy
3. Allow user to Copy instrument(s)
4. Allow user to Confirm for Copy before user can proceed to 'Copy'

integration.details:
1. Webhook Status Update Api
2. Withdraw Lodgment API

frontend.details:
Lodgment Form enhancement: per-instrument Withdraw action link (for Submitted/Objected), row checkboxes with a conditional multi-select Withdraw button (appears at ≥2 selected), confirm popup, success toast, and greyed-out link/checkbox with a "withdrawal in progress" tooltip.
Copy Instrument action link on Withdrawn rows → confirm popup → navigate to the (existing) pre-filled Create Instrument page.
Concurrent-access error popup ("instrument currently in use…") with an Ok button on both Withdraw and Copy.

backend.details:
New Withdraw endpoint POST /lodgement/{lodgementId}/withdraw — eligibility guards, orchestration, persist withdrawal rows after ELS success.
New Copy endpoint POST /legal-instrument/{instrumentId}/copy — deep-copy the instrument aggregate into a fresh PREPARATION draft.
New ElsWithdrawFacade (SigV4 + Resilience4j CB/retry) calling ELS directly.
New webhook handler — add

interface.details:
Outbound (new): POST {ELS}/api/v2/withdraw-lodgement with SigV4 + agency-law-firm / agency-user-id headers; body carries lodgerAcct, lodgmentNo, instrumentList[]; returns a requestId.
Inbound (extended): existing status-update webhook now handles updateType = "Withdrawal" (per-instrument Approved/NotApproved + reasons) plus the combined lodgmentUpdate for status transitions.

database.details:
One new table InstrumentWithdrawal (instrument-level: instrument id, lodgment no, lodger acct, ELS requestId, status, reason, status datetime; unique-active-per-instrument).
New CodeTable master data: lodgment status REQUEST_FOR_WITHDRAW; withdrawal statuses REQUESTED/APPROVED/NOT_APPROVED; audit action types WITHDRAW_REQUEST/WITHDRAW_STATUS_UPDATE/COPY_INSTRUMENT.

qa.details: New test cases for the withdrawal feature and the copy instrument

backend.details: New API endpoint integration and changes

database.details: Two new columns are added under the instrument table

qa.details: Need to right new test cases for the cost api negative scenarios and new popup message

rows.business_requirement: AC1.1-AC1.3 (Withdraw flow) - On the Lodgment Form, view lodged instruments with per-instrument withdraw eligibility withdraw a single instrument via the Withdraw action link or multiple (>=2 selected) via the Withdraw button confirmation popup -> raise the withdrawal request to ELS -> success toast the Withdraw link + checkbox are greyed out with a 'withdrawal in progress' tooltip and no further withdrawal is allowed while pending.
rows.technical_component:
UI (Medium)
Lodgment Form enhancement: per-instrument Withdraw action link (Submitted/Objected), 
1. Row checkboxes with a conditional multi-select Withdraw button (shown when >=2 selected, hiding the per-row links)
2. Confirmation popup, success toast.
3. Greyed link/checkbox + in-progress tooltip. 
Reuses the existing Lodgment Form / Lodged Instruments layout.
MS (Complex) - ms-legalinstrument
NEW API: POST /api/ext/v1/lodgement/{lodgementId}/withdraw (WithdrawInstrumentOrchestrator) - eligibility guards (lodgment SUBMITTED instrument Submitted/Objected/Accepted/Instrument-with-error not already pending lodging firm only BR5 not suspended BR4), resolve ELS instrument numbers, persist InstrumentWithdrawal rows only after ELS success.
NEW outbound: POST {ELS}/api/v2/withdraw-lodgement via NEW ElsWithdrawFacade (SigV4 headers agency-law-firm/agency-user-id Resilience4j CB+retry).
EXISTING to MODIFY: lodgement/dashboard read API - expose per-instrument withdrawable + withdrawalPending flags.

rows.business_requirement: AC1.4 (ELS status sync) - Once DCP receives a status update from ELS, the lodgment status and the instrument status are updated and displayed in the Lodged Instruments section, reflecting the per-instrument withdrawal outcome (Approved / NotApproved with reason).
rows.technical_component:
MS (Medium) - ms-legalinstrument
NEW webhook route: add updateType=Withdrawal to ElsWebhookUpdateType + NEW WithdrawalUpdateHandler (registered in the existing StatusUpdateHandlerRegistry) - match InstrumentWithdrawal by requestId + instrumentNumber and set APPROVED / NOT_APPROVED + reasonCode/description/statusDateTime.
EXISTING to REUSE/CHECK: POST /api/ext/v1/legal-instrument/webhook/status-update (StatusUpdateOrchestrator) idempotency via x-request-id the existing LodgmentUpdateHandler applies the combined lodgmentUpdate in the same payload (Instrument -> Withdrawn/Registered Lodgement -> REQUEST_FOR_WITHDRAW / Withdrawn).

rows.business_requirement: AC1.5 / AC1.5.1 (Copy Instrument) - For instruments with Lodgment Status = Withdrawn, expose a Copy Instrument action on confirm, open the Create Instrument page pre-filled with all details from the withdrawn instrument the user can Save as Draft and proceed to create and re-lodge (existing flow).
rows.technical_component:
UI (Simple)
Copy Instrument action link on Withdrawn rows + confirmation popup + navigation to the (existing) Create Instrument page pre-filled from the copy regression of the existing create/draft/lodge flow.
MS (Complex) - ms-legalinstrument
NEW API: POST /api/ext/v1/legal-instrument/{instrumentId}/copy (CopyInstrumentService) - deep-copy InstrumentJson + child rows (InstrumentProfile, LandDescription, InstrumentSigning, ShareInLand, InstrumentCertification) into a new PREPARATION instrument (new id, cleared number/version/errors) and capture copy lineage (source instrument id + number).
EXISTING to REUSE: create/draft persistence + validation and the Create Instrument page.

rows.business_requirement: AC1.6 / AC1.7 (Concurrent access) - When another user from the same law firm acts on the same instrument's Withdraw or Copy CTA, show 'The instrument is currently in use by another user. Please try again later.' with an Ok button (Withdraw -> user stays on the Lodgment form Copy -> user is returned to the Legal Instruments tab).
rows.technical_component:
MS (Simple) - ms-legalinstrument
Integrate the EXISTING Resource-Manager concurrency-lock framework into the withdraw + copy endpoints and map the in-use condition to the standard concurrent-access (409) error.
UI (Simple)
Concurrent-access error popup with an Ok button on both the Withdraw and Copy actions, with the correct post-Ok navigation per AC.
[Assumption: the lock framework already exists (SLADCYBQSK-23403) - integration only, not designed here.]

rows.business_requirement: TAC-1/2/5 - Real-time ELS cost at Prepare Lodgement: call ELS calculate-fee (batched) using the lodger-account headers, expose a cache-first per-instrument fee endpoint, compute per-instrument total (fee+gst) and the lodgement grand total, and display them in the Prepare Lodgement popup.
rows.technical_component:
MS (Complex) - ms-legalinstrument
NEW API: POST /api/ext/v1/lodgement/instrument-fee (InstrumentFeeService) - cache-first (reuse stored fee), batch-call ELS only for misses, compute totals.
NEW outbound: POST {ELS}/api/v2/calculate-fee via NEW ElsCalculateFeeFacade + ElsCalculateFeeClient (SigV4 + agency-law-firm/agency-user-id headers, Resilience4j CB+retry).
EXISTING to REUSE: LodgerAccountService (header values) NEW FeeAmountParser (comma-string -> BigDecimal, no rounding).

rows.business_requirement: TAC-3/4/6 - Persist fee+GST on the instrument (frozen once captured), invalidate & recalculate on instrument edit/re-submit, and derive the submit-time LodgementAmount from the stored instrument fees.
rows.technical_component:
MS (Medium) - ms-legalinstrument
Persist InstrumentEstimatedFee + InstrumentGst on ELS success (freeze) reuse when already present.
EXISTING to MODIFY: draft edit + submit-to-ELS persistence - clear stored fee/GST on edit/re-submit (new InstrumentNumber/version).
EXISTING to MODIFY: POST /api/ext/v1/lodgement/submit-lodgement (LodgmentSyncServiceImpl) - LodgementAmount = sum(stored fee+gst) carried via the existing lodgment-sync payload (no new ELS field).

rows.business_requirement: TAC-7 - Fallback & error handling: config instrumentPrice fallback when ELS is unavailable (and, pending Jerry's approval, on Instrument_Number_Not_Found) block the Prepare Lodgement screen on ELS 422 or when no cost can be determined.
